candidate_structure.information_flow: The first call receives every common input and emits only an analysis that synthesizes generative evidence against normative obligations. The final call consumes that analysis, directly receives only task, anchor_contract, and task_constraints, has no direct visibility of anchor_policy, candidate_hypothesis, or loop_structure, and emits one complete policy.
candidate_structure.name: Permanent Source-Class Cut
candidate_structure.organization: two-call sequential lineage with an unconditional generative-source cut on the terminal edge

calls.objective: Reconcile inherited and counter-generative claims against normative obligations, preserve conflicts and supporting distinctions, and emit only an analysis without creating a policy artifact.
Consume synthesize_cut_sources, directly reconcile its claims with the visible normative inputs, and emit one complete policy without reacquiring the cut generative sources.

mode_certificate.forbidden_inherited_mechanism: terminal lossless evidence reacquisition of all six common inputs
mode_certificate.independent_replacement_principle: Generative evidence receives one upstream synthesis, while terminal authority directly sees only normative evidence and the resulting analysis.
rejected_assumptions: Reliable policy emission requires terminal reacquisition of every common input.
Inherited and counter-generative sources should remain directly co-visible at terminal authority.
Upstream counter-analysis must remain defeasible through terminal rereading of its original generative sources.

qualitative_hypothesis.causal_change: Permanently remove direct terminal visibility of anchor_policy, candidate_hypothesis, and loop_structure while retaining direct terminal visibility of task, anchor_contract, and task_constraints.
qualitative_hypothesis.expected_effect: Generative evidence is synthesized earlier with reduced terminal anchor dependence, while contract reconciliation remains directly grounded at emission.
qualitative_hypothesis.falsifier: all-valid matched majority and strict-median contract, with no score
qualitative_hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: Lossless terminal reacquisition lets inherited generative sources dominate the upstream counter-analysis and postpones evidence settlement until policy emission.

structural_mutation.after: The terminal authority consumes the preceding analysis and directly reacquires only task, anchor_contract, and task_constraints; direct edges from anchor_policy, candidate_hypothesis, and loop_structure are absent.
structural_mutation.before: The terminal authority reacquires all six common inputs and may reinterpret the preceding analysis against every original source.
structural_mutation.factor: fixed generative-source edge cut with normative-source terminal visibility
structural_mutation.why_structural: The mutation permanently changes terminal graph connectivity and evidence authority through one source-class visibility partition, rather than renaming or splitting roles.

receipt.role: score-blind R63 counter_hypothesis structure architect; never policy code
